headline_marked: Stoppage time goal: [[Valverde rescues Real Madrid]] in 3-2 win over AEK Athens
headline: Stoppage time goal: Valverde rescues Real Madrid in 3-2 win over AEK Athens
summary: Federico Valverde's late strike secures a dramatic victory for Real Madrid, while Liverpool suffers a 3-2 defeat to Fenerbahce.
details: Federico Valverde scored in stoppage time to give Real Madrid a 3-2 victory over AEK Athens on Wednesday. The Spanish giants twice came from behind to maintain their perfect start to the campaign.

AEK Athens took an early lead in the 12th minute through Aboubakary Koita. Jude Bellingham equalized five minutes later with a deft backheel, but Stavros Pilios restored AEK's lead in the 75th minute.
Kylian Mbappe tapped in a cross from Denzel Dumfries in the 78th minute to level the score. Valverde then delivered the winning goal in the final moments of the match.
In another Champions League clash, Liverpool suffered a 3-2 defeat at Fenerbahce. Despite leading twice, the Turkish side secured the win with a 79th-minute goal from Vedat Muriqi.
Liverpool's goals were scored by Trey Nyoni, Alexander Isak, and Cody Gakpo, while Fenerbahce's goals came from Mason Greenwood, Archie Brown, and Vedat Muriqi.
Real Madrid now sit second in their group with 12 points from four matches, while Liverpool has dropped to fifth place with nine points.
caption:
A dramatic stoppage-time winner! ⚽️

Federico Valverde rescues Real Madrid in a 3-2 thriller against AEK Athens.

Federico Valverde scored in stoppage time to give Real Madrid a 3-2 victory over AEK Athens on Wednesday. The Spanish giants twice came from behind to maintain their perfect start to the campaign.

AEK Athens took an early lead in the 12th minute through Aboubakary Koita. Jude Bellingham equalized five minutes later with a deft backheel, but Stavros Pilios restored AEK's lead in the 75th minute.

Kylian Mbappe tapped in a cross from Denzel Dumfries in the 78th minute to level the score. Valverde then delivered the winning goal in the final moments of the match.

In another Champions League clash, Liverpool suffered a 3-2 defeat at Fenerbahce. Despite leading twice, the Turkish side secured the win with a 79th-minute goal from Vedat Muriqi.

Liverpool's goals were scored by Trey Nyoni, Alexander Isak, and Cody Gakpo, while Fenerbahce's goals came from Mason Greenwood, Archie Brown, and Vedat Muriqi.

Real Madrid now sit second in their group with 12 points from four matches, while Liverpool has dropped to fifth place with nine points.

headline: Democratic sweep: Democrats win US Congress in midterm rout of Trump
summary: The Democratic party has achieved a significant victory in the US midterm elections, signaling a strong rebuke of Donald Trump's presidency.
details: Democrats have achieved a significant sweep in the US midterm elections, winning seats in both the House and the House of Representatives, gaining leverage over Donald Trump's economic and foreign policy agendas.

caption:
A historic Democratic sweep in the US midterms has delivered a a verdict on Donald Trump's presidency.

Democrats have achieved a significant sweep in the US midterm elections, winning seats in both the House and the House of Representatives, gaining leverage over Donald Trump's economic and foreign policy agendas.

Estimates put the Democratic lead in the House vote by about 13 percentage points, which may be the widest margin for either party in a congressional election since 1976.
